propositions: The rebar-gerrit-voter-errors alarm fires on isolated transient self-healing errors (review timeout, curl stalls, retryable gaps) that require no operator intervention, causing false-positive pages.

Sustained voter failures (expired token, LLM outage, Gerrit down) produce continuous marker streams across consecutive 5-minute evaluation periods and must alarm loudly while transient single-period events do not.

The alarm must be recalibrated from single-period (1x300s, Sum>0) to sustained N-of-M detection (3-of-5: evaluation_periods=5, datapoints_to_alarm=3) to discriminate by persistence rather than magnitude.

Isolated self-healing markers breach at most 2 consecutive periods (including boundary straddles) and never trigger the 3-of-3 threshold; sustained marker streams trigger alarm within ~15 minutes at the 3rd breaching period.
